chose: Home files issues as its own GitHub App, with Issues read and write, Pull requests read and Metadata read, and no webhook; the owner creates it, installs it on the repositories home may file into, and adds its app ID, installation ID and private key to deploy/home/file_host.sops.env, from which home mints one-hour installation tokens. Owner, verbatim: "go with the GitHub App".
undo: Uninstall the app and remove its three values from file_host.sops.env; filing turns off. A token of the owner's in their place is a new call.
